analysis_md: 由 $z=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$ 与 $x^2+y^2+z^2=2$ 联立得 $x^2+y^2=1,z=1$。球面坐标下 $0\leq\theta\leq2\pi,0\leq\varphi\leq\pi/4,0\leq r\leq\sqrt2$，故 $\iiint_\Omega z\,dv=\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^{\pi/4}d\varphi\int_0^{\sqrt2}r\cos\varphi\cdot r^2\sin\varphi\,dr=2\pi\int_0^{\pi/4}\sin\varphi\cos\varphi\,d\varphi=\pi/2$。
